meta.title: Order at your table | Billy Belly Chicken

order.howItWorks: Add dishes, place the order. Your waiter will confirm it with you and tell the chef. Pay at the counter. No online payment.
order.invalidText: The QR code looks wrong or the table number does not exist. Please ask your waiter for help.
order.closedText: The kitchen is not taking orders right now. Please speak to the staff.
order.cartEmpty: Your cart is empty. Add something tasty.
order.notePh: Note for the chef (e.g. less spicy)
order.placedText: Your waiter will come to confirm it with you shortly.
order.noOrders: No orders yet. Add dishes from the menu.
order.cancelHint: Can be cancelled until the waiter confirms.
order.cancelFail: The waiter has already confirmed this order. Please ask the waiter.
order.callCooldown: We already called your waiter. Please wait a moment.
order.billAsked: Bill requested. Your waiter will bring the bill summary.
order.dupText: You sent an identical order a moment ago. Send it again?
order.cooldown: Please wait {n} seconds before the next order.
order.soldOut: Some dishes just sold out and were removed from your cart.
order.badTokenText: The waiter closed the table. Start a new session to order again.
order.thanksTitle: Thank you for dining with us
order.thanksText: Your table is closed. We hope the food made you happy. Tell us how it was.
